evidence: Introduces common::Setting and refactors ArgsManager registration and lookup across src/common/args* and src/init*.
rationale: Provides a comprehensive compile-time type-safety overhaul for repository-wide configuration settings. The author notes that 'nothing checks that setting names are spelled correctly, or that default values are used consistently in the help string and retrieval sites', eliminating a wide class of silent configuration bugs and unblocking runtime setting validation in #22978.
